description: Show only part of a video clip: rectangle (rounded), ellipse, linear, mirror, heart, star or polygon, with feather and invert. Position, size, rotation and feather animate like transform values. null removes the mask. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

keyframes.description: frame is relative to the clip start; ease from video://catalog/eases

corner_radius.description: rectangle: corner radius as a fraction of its short side

feather.description: Soft edge as a fraction of the picture short side

height.description: Fraction of the picture height (default 0.5); band thickness for mirror; 0 to 10

points.description: polygon: [x, y] corners in the clip picture, 0–1

rotation.description: Degrees clockwise; for linear, the edge angle; -36000 to 36000

width.description: Fraction of the picture width (default 0.5); 0 to 10

x.description: Mask centre x in the clip picture, 0–1 (default 0.5); -4 to 5

y.description: Mask centre y in the clip picture, 0–1 (default 0.5); -4 to 5

preview.description: inline: image in the result; link: URI that renders on read; none

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

loudness.description: Measured for audio edits, over the waveform span
